summary: Frontend testing of BubbleSelect component and iOS 26 style dropdowns on mobile viewport (390x844). All requested features verified working: BubbleSelect opens/closes correctly on mobile, shows glassmorphism/backdrop-blur effect, SocialLinkSelector uses BubbleSelect for social type selection, native selects have bubble-native-select class, and Mascotas/Pets specific fields appear when selected.
critical_code_review_comments: BubbleSelect component correctly implements iOS 26 style with backdrop-filter: blur(20px) on trigger and blur(30px) on options
Semi-transparent backgrounds: trigger uses rgba(255,255,255,0.7), options use rgba(255,255,255,0.92)
Touch events work correctly on mobile - onClick handlers properly close dropdown after selection
SocialLinkSelector correctly uses BubbleSelect for social network type selection with icons
All native selects in ProfileSpecificFields have bubble-native-select class applied (Species, Size, Vaccinated, Sterilized)
Mascotas/Pets card type shows all specific fields when selected (Pet Information, Medical Info, If Lost section)
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user from previous iterations

bubble_select_mobile_functionality.details: BubbleSelect opens on click, shows 7 card type options, closes correctly after selection

social_link_selector_bubble_select.details: SocialLinkSelector uses BubbleSelect for social network type with icons (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter/X, TikTok, YouTube, WhatsApp, Email, Phone, Website, Custom)

native_selects_bubble_style.details: All 4 native selects in ProfileSpecificFields (mascotas) have bubble-native-select class: Species, Size, Vaccinated, Sterilized

mascotas_fields_display.details: When Mascotas/Pets is selected, Pet Information section appears with petName, species, breed, age, color, size, identifyingMarks fields

dropdown_close_on_selection.details: Dropdown closes correctly after selecting an option (verified with is_visible check returning False)
